intro: My research sits at the intersection of finance, econometrics and computational methods. I study how financial markets work, how scientific knowledge is produced and rewarded, and how open data and software can make empirical research more reproducible.

themes.title: Market microstructure and liquidity
themes.summary: How prices form in Brazilian markets, how liquidity varies across assets and venues, and what high-frequency data reveal about trading and market quality.

themes.title: Financial econometrics and volatility
themes.summary: Time-series models for volatility, risk forecasting and the empirical behaviour of financial returns.

themes.title: Science of science and publishing
themes.summary: Bibliometrics, predatory publishing, academic inbreeding and the incentives that shape scientific production.

themes.title: Open data, reproducibility and software
themes.summary: Building open-source tools that make Brazilian financial and economic data accessible, reproducible and easy to analyse in R and Python.

themes.title: Artificial intelligence and LLMs in finance
themes.summary: How large language models and machine learning are changing financial analysis, research and academic publishing.
